messages:
Asha: Uploaded the product launch blog draft for Optimize. Need fast pass on hero line, one benchmark sentence, CTA phrasing, and confirm publish slot. Doc: https://go/redwood/optimize-launch-draft :wave:

Tom: Will read hero + bench now. Prefer publish 11am ET (which is 8am PT) or 10am PT? open to either.

Riley: Tiny wording suggestion: change 'saves 40% tokens' -> 'reduces effective token cost by ~40%'. More accurate.

Asha: Good. Also need a short technical quote from Priya for the hero. Priya?

Priya: Drafting something short: 
```
"Optimize surfaces batching and quantization choices so teams can serve high-quality models at lower cost."
```
Open to edits.

Tom: Could be tighter for social: 
```
"Optimize surfaces batching and quantization to cut inference cost without trading latency."
```

Riley: That reads a little clunky. Maybe: 
```
"Optimize cuts inference cost while keeping latency production-grade."
```

Priya: Fine with that. Legal, any concerns about the bench claim or 'production-grade'? @LegalBot

LegalBot: Quickpass: bench phrasing is ok with 'effective token cost' hedge. Recommend 'production-grade' > 'production-ready' as it sounds less absolute.

Asha: Great. CTA suggestion: 'Try Optimize free — get tailored batching guidance and cost estimates.' OK?

Tom: Yep. Growth wants UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=post`

Priya: UTMs added to CTA link.

SchedulerBot: Tentative publish scheduled for 2026-03-23T11:00:00-04:00. Confirm before EOD. Smoke test at T-30m reminder.

Riley: I'll run the T-30m copy check and validate code embeds.

Tom: I'll prepare social cards and the benchmark tweet thread.

Asha: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD we'll lock the slot. Ping here for any last-minute changes. :rocket:
